summary: Frontend-only UX verification of the 5 new features on the public preview URL (demo@masterai.com). VERIFIED PASSING: (1) Ask AI shows BOTH CTAs [one-more-round]/[good-for-today] with correct labels, 'One More Round' re-mounts the SAME answer for another rep, 'I'm Good for Today' clears back to the empty question box, and the default [restart-button] is correctly replaced by the custom actions; (2) SPACEBAR on the Ask AI result card triggers One More Round without clicking; (3) SPACEBAR on the Typing Practice result card loads a NEW text (verified text changed); (4) SPACEBAR on the LessonRunner per-passage result card advances to the next passage (used for all 6 passages of a course); (5) Learn-from-Scratch Complete screen shows all three actions [runner-restart], [learn-more-button]='Learn More →', [test-yourself-button] plus the 'press space to keep learning' hint, and SPACE puts Learn More into the 'Building next level…' disabled loading state (then recovers cleanly on failure); (6) Word of the Day own-word lookup works ([lookup-word-input] 'ephemeral' + [lookup-word-button] -> card updates with word/part-of-speech/meaning + 3 examples, success toast), and SPACE after finishing an example advances exactly ONE example with a clean (empty) input and 100% accuracy - the [next-example-button] click path also works; (7) Learn-from-Documents dropzone helper text reads 'PDF · DOCX · TXT · Image (JPG/PNG) — up to 10 MB', file-input accept='.pdf,.docx,.txt,.md,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,image/*', PNG upload fires the request with the 'Reading & building lessons…' busy state, and the previously OCR'd image document ('The Earth Water Cycle' / notes_img.png) opens with a FileImage icon and type-over lessons. BLOCKED: the two AI-generating end states (Learn More navigating to a NEW course id, and a fresh image OCR upload) could NOT be completed because the user's Gemini free-tier DAILY request quota (20 requests/day for gemini-3-flash) is exhausted - /api/ai/course and /api/documents/upload now return 500 (upstream 429).

critical.issue: Gemini free-tier quota exhausted (quotaId GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier, limit 20/day for gemini-3-flash). Every AI call now fails; backend converts the upstream 429/503 into a generic HTTP 500 with NO retry/backoff. Blocks Learn More (infinity loop) and image OCR verification.

Raw upstream error text is leaked to the end user: toast shows "Could not read text from the image: Client error '429 Too Many Requests' for url 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3-flash-preview:generateContent' ..." - exposes provider, model and MDN links. Map 429->429/503 with a friendly 'AI is busy, try again in a minute' message.

The plan credit is incremented BEFORE the AI call and is never refunded when generation fails. Every 429/503/500 permanently burns one of the user's monthly course/ask/word/document credits (reproduced: failed image upload consumed a 'document' credit, failed Learn More consumed a 'course' credit).

minor.issue: Not cached per day: every visit to /app/word calls Gemini and returns a DIFFERENT word (observed alacrity, ubiquitous, ephemeral, Fastidious, eloquent within ~15 minutes) and consumes a 'word' credit each time. A 'Word of the Day' should be deterministic per (date[,user]) and cached in Mongo; re-visits should not consume credits.

integration_issues.flow: Learn from Scratch -> Learn More (infinity loop)
integration_issues.issue: Could not be verified end-to-end: POST /ai/course returns 500 (Gemini daily quota). Frontend behaviour up to that point is correct (loading label, disabled button, state resets afterwards), but the navigation to /app/learn/<new id> remains UNVERIFIED. Also the failure only surfaces as a transient toast - no inline retry affordance on the Complete screen.

Upload wiring/busy state/error toast all work, but the OCR->document navigation is UNVERIFIED for a fresh image because /documents/upload returns 500 (Gemini daily quota). An older image-derived doc renders correctly.
On a 500 from /ai/course the page stays on /app/learn with only a toast; no inline error/retry state (loading state itself resets correctly).

action_items: Gemini key has hit the free-tier 20-requests/day cap - upgrade the key/billing or the app is unusable; re-run the Learn More + image-OCR frontend tests once quota is available.
Add retry-with-backoff for upstream 429/503 in ai_service._generate and map upstream 429/503 to 429/503 with a user-friendly message instead of a 500 that leaks the provider URL/model.
Refund (or consume-after-success) the plan credit when the AI call fails in check_and_consume - failures currently burn user quota.
Cache Word of the Day per date (Mongo) so the word is stable for the day and repeat visits don't call Gemini / consume credits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: check_and_consume() is called before every AI request and there is no compensating decrement in the except blocks - wrap in try/except and $inc -1 on failure, or consume only after a successful generation.
server.py: HTTPException(detail=f"...: {e}") for AI errors serialises the raw httpx.HTTPStatusError (URL, model, provider) into the API response and therefore into the UI toast - sanitise.
ai_service.py: no retry/backoff; a single 429 (Gemini RPM/RPD) kills a whole user flow after the credit was already charged.

WordOfDay.jsx/LessonRunner.jsx/TypingPractice.jsx spacebar handlers are correct (single fire, preventDefault stops the char reaching the next hidden input) - verified with a clean run; no change needed.
GET /ai/word-of-day has no per-day cache, making the feature non-deterministic and quota-hungry.

success_rate.backend: not in scope (observed 500s on /ai/course and /documents/upload due to Gemini daily quota)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (11/13 sub-checks passed; 2 AI-dependent end states blocked by provider quota, none failed on frontend logic)

seed_data_creation: Used existing demo@masterai.com data. Typed through existing course course_4f72518ce9eb (French Greetings for Beginners) and doc doc_bc8bccfc4598; created /tmp/ocr_test.png (text-bearing PNG via PIL) for the image-upload test. Reset test_database.usage counters to 0 several times.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright notes: do NOT extract the passage text with inner_text() - inline-block word wrapping doubles the spaces and the extra characters leak into the NEXT engine (this caused a false 'space skips an example' bug in this run). Use: document.querySelector('[data-testid="type-over-engine"] .relative') then join the leaf <span> textContents and replace \u00a0 with a space. Then click [type-over-engine] and page.keyboard.type(text, delay=3). Remaining UNVERIFIED items: (a) Learn More actually navigating to a NEW /app/learn/<id>, (b) fresh PNG/JPG OCR upload navigating to /app/documents/<id>. Both need Gemini quota (free tier = 20 requests/day for gemini-3-flash; reset with a paid key or wait for the daily reset). Reset plan usage with: python3 -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; from dotenv import dotenv_values; e=dotenv_values('/app/backend/.env'); MongoClient(e['MONGO_URL'])[e['DB_NAME']]['usage'].update_many({},{'$set':{'course':0,'ask':0,'quiz':0,'document':0,'word':0}})".
rca_of_the_issue: All observed failures trace to one root cause: the configured Gemini API key is on the free tier whose GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel quota for gemini-3-flash is 20/day, which this session exhausted. ai_service._generate calls r.raise_for_status() with no retry, and the route handlers re-raise as HTTPException(500, f'...{e}'), so the UI shows a raw provider error and the user's plan credit (already incremented by check_and_consume) is lost. The initially suspected spacebar defect in Word of the Day (advance 1 -> 3 plus a stray space char in the next input) was NOT an app bug: it was caused by the test harness typing doubled spaces extracted via inner_text, which overshot the passage length and leaked keystrokes; a clean run advanced exactly one example with an empty input and 100% accuracy.
